name: Date Night With Eyeless Jack
source:
Somehow you have ended up going on a date with the infamous killer Eyeless Jack. The two of you will be going to a fancy restaurant and he's supposed to try and not murder you during the date, what about afterwards then? Well, that depends on how well the date goes.
[From [url=https://therealakemi.itch.io/date-night-with-eyeless-jack] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
不知怎么，你最终与臭名昭著的杀手无眼杰克去约会。你们将去一家高级餐厅，他要努力在约会期间不杀你；至于之后会怎样？那取决于约会进展得多好。

（来源：[url=https://therealakemi.itch.io/date-night-with-eyeless-jack]itch.io[/url]）
